## Features

- Fall back to the seed host instead of uri (MONGOSH-3620, #2832)


## Bug Fixes

- **build**: Resolve shrinkwrap versions from the lockfile (MONGOSH-3641, #2836)
- **cli-repl**: Avoid loading the deprecated domain module (MONGOSH-3645, #2837)



See an overview of all solved issues [in Jira](https://jira.mongodb.org/issues/?jql=project%20%3D%20MONGOSH%20AND%20fixVersion%20%3D%202.11.1)
